articles.title: Toronto police searching for missing person
articles.summary: Investigators say Christine, 23, was last seen at 8 a.m. on Friday in the area of Dixon Road and Martin Grove Road.

articles.title: Man seriously injured in Brampton stabbing; suspect sought
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police (PRP) investigators are searching for a suspect following a stabbing in Brampton. Emergency crews were called to College Plaza near Steeles Avenue West and McLaughlin Road South around 5 a.m. on Monday. articles.title: Toronto police investigating shooting near U.S. Consulate; suspect at large
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a gunshot was heard early Monday morning near the U.S. Consulate building in the city’s downtown core. Officers were called around 4:45 a.m. to the Armoury Street and University Avenue area, a zone that includes the consulate and several government buildings. Police say evidence of a firearm discharge was found […]

articles.title: Driver seriously injured after vehicle slams into pole in Toronto’s west end
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a single‑vehicle collision early Monday after a male driver crashed into a pole in the city’s west end. articles.title: Boy, 11, hospitalized after scooter collision in Toronto’s west end; Police seek 2 drivers
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a collision in the city’s west end after an 11‑year‑old boy lost control of his electric scooter and struck a parked van, leaving him with significant injuries. articles.title: Body found near train tracks in Brampton being investigated as suspicious death: police
articles.summary: Peel police say they are investigating a suspicious death after a body was found near train tracks in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: Hundreds of Torontonians celebrate after feds reject Billy Bishop jet expansion
articles.summary: Hundreds of Toronto residents and advocates are celebrating after the federal government rejected support for a proposed expansion to accommodate jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport.

articles.title: Carney calls August byelection for Beaches-East York riding
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has called three byelections in the B.C. riding of North Vancouver–Capilano, the Ontario riding of Beaches-East York and the Quebec riding of Chicoutimi—Le Fjord.

articles.title: Blaze damages 5 homes, displaces residents in Mississauga
articles.summary: Firefighters extinguished a house fire that spread to "several" nearby resident units in Mississauga on Saturday evening, Peel Regional Police said.

articles.title: Federal government says it won't support Ontario's Billy Bishop Airport expansion plans
articles.summary: The federal government says it won't support Ontario Premier Doug Ford's plan to expand Billy Bishop Airport to allow jets to take off and land there.
